articles.title: How brain-eating amoebas may wriggle into someone’s brain
articles.snippet: Naegleria amoebas are dogged explorers, especially in tight spaces. These behaviors might help these brain-eating microbes crawl into our heads.
articles.summary: Naegleria amoebas are explorers that like tight spaces. These behaviors might help the brain-eating microbes crawl into our heads.

articles.title: Ocean cold snaps can imperil sea turtles. Rescuers can help
articles.snippet: Climate-driven ocean changes are stranding thousands of sea turtles on beaches, too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals give some a fighting chance.
articles.summary: Climate-driven ocean changes are stranding thousands of sea turtles on beaches because they are too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals are now helping to save these animals and give them a fighting chance.

articles.title: Some video games offer mental-health benefits
articles.snippet: The PlaySmart video game lowered teens’ symptoms of depression. This benefit was still there a year after they stopped playing the game.
articles.summary: Playing the video game PlaySmart lowered depression symptoms in teens. This mental health benefit lasted for a year after they stopped playing.
